primary_statistic: MAE(model) minus MAE(persistence), MoCA points. Negative favors the model.
interval: Pointwise 95% conditional paired percentile intervals using linear quantiles, one identity per row within horizon and view. Sort by identity before sampling. PCG64, same draws for every method and contrast. No redraw.
undefined: R2 undefined when SST=0. Calibration intercept and slope undefined when prediction range <=1e-12. Retain negative R2. Missing or undefined results reported as null.
bias: Prediction minus observation. Calibration is descriptive OLS of observed on predicted. Outside-range fraction uses raw prediction. No clipping or recalibration.
multiplicity: One leading contrast per scientific question. All other estimates and comparisons descriptive. No joint significance claim across the two studies or equivalence margin.
handling: Do not impute outcomes, exclude outliers after prediction or tune in the target. Use exact audited membership and one outcome per component/horizon. Report all horizons even with imprecise intervals.
authorization: Local protocol and synthetic validation only. Study prediction and evaluation require subsequent user instruction.
population: 201 PDBP identity components after baseline PD, age 18–89, sex, >12 years of education, M0 plus unique M12/M24/M36, concordant domain sums/adjustment and known PPMI/LCC identity and released WGS QC exclusions. No age/education imputation. Baseline and follow-up both explicitly indicate greater than 12 years, consistent with baseline demographics. Source baseline was anchored to GDS, target baseline is M0.
interpretation: External transport of the three-input equations under scheduled-visit timing and domain-concordant total scores. Actual dates, fully item-verified totals, complete disposition and cutoff unavailable. Independence bounded by available links.
fit: At each horizon use its independently verified PPMI Reduced3 regression with ordered baseline MoCA, completed age and sex (male=1), and exact stored center, scale, intercept and coefficients. Three equations total.
reference: Persistence = baseline MoCA. Typical change = baseline plus the PPMI source mean change for the corresponding reduced-model training sample.
comparison: Every pair within each view, first minus second in listed order. Strict education is the frozen >16 demographic-band sensitivity.
precision: Report conditional intervals and denominators at each nominal visit. Sample estimates apply to available follow-up among eligible participants.
